items.source: In addition to standard BeanFactory lifecycle capabilities, ApplicationContext implementations detect and invoke ApplicationContextAware beans as well as ResourceLoaderAware, ApplicationEventPublisherAware and MessageSourceAware beans.
items.translation: 除了标准的BeanFactory生命周期功能外，ApplicationContext 实现还会检测并调用ApplicationContextAware以及ResourceLoaderAware、ApplicationEventPublisherAware和MessageSourceAwarebean。

items.source: Alternatively, the internal BeanFactory exposed by the ConfigurableApplicationContext interface offers access to the AutowireCapableBeanFactory interface too. The present method mainly serves as a convenient, specific facility on the ApplicationContext interface.
items.translation: 或者，由ConfigurableApplicationContext接口暴露的内部 BeanFactory 也提供了对AutowireCapableBeanFactory接口的访问。当前方法主要作为 ApplicationContext 接口上的一种便捷、特定的设施。

items.source: NOTE: As of 4.2, this method will consistently throw IllegalStateException after the application context has been closed. In current Spring Framework versions, only refreshable application contexts behave that way; as of 4.2, all application context implementations will be required to comply.
items.translation: 注意：自 4.2 版本起，在应用程序上下文关闭后，此方法将始终抛出 IllegalStateException。 在当前版本的 Spring Framework 中，仅可刷新式的应用程序上下文会表现出这种行为；自 4.2 版本起，所有应用程序上下文实现都将需要遵守此规定。

items.source: An ApplicationContext provides:
items.translation: ApplicationContext 提供：

items.source:
This is not typically used by application code, except for the purpose of
initializing bean instances that live outside the application context,
applying the Spring bean lifecycle (fully or partly) to them.
items.translation: 这通常不由应用程序代码使用，除非用于初始化位于应用程序上下文之外的 Bean 实例，并将 Spring Bean 生命周期（全部或部分）应用于这些实例。

items.source: Return the parent context, or null if there is no parent and this is the root of the context hierarchy.
items.translation: 返回父上下文，或者如果不存在父上下文且此为上下文层次结构的根节点，则返回 `null`。

items.source: Return a name for the deployed application that this context belongs to.
items.translation: 返回此上下文所属的已部署应用程序的名称。

items.source: Return a friendly name for this context.
items.translation: 为此上下文返回一个友好的名称。

items.source: Return the unique id of this application context.
items.translation: 返回此应用上下文的唯一 ID。

items.source: Return the timestamp when this context was first loaded.
items.translation: 返回首次加载此上下文时的时间戳。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the context does not support the AutowireCapableBeanFactory interface, or does not hold an autowire-capable bean factory yet (for example, if refresh() has never been called), or if the context has been closed already
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果上下文不支持AutowireCapableBeanFactory接口，或者尚未持有自动装配功能的 BeanFactory（例如，如果从未调用过refresh()），或者上下文已经被关闭。

items.source: Bean factory methods for accessing application components. Inherited from ListableBeanFactory.
items.translation: 用于访问应用程序组件的 Bean 工厂方法。继承自ListableBeanFactory。

items.source: The ability to load file resources in a generic fashion. Inherited from the ResourceLoader interface.
items.translation: 以通用方式加载文件资源的能力。 继承自ResourceLoader接口。

items.source: The ability to publish events to registered listeners. Inherited from the ApplicationEventPublisher interface.
items.translation: 向已注册的监听器发布事件的能力。 继承自ApplicationEventPublisher接口。

items.source: The ability to resolve messages, supporting internationalization. Inherited from the MessageSource interface.
items.translation: 解析消息以支持国际化的能力。继承自MessageSource接口。

items.source: the unique id of the context, or null if none
items.translation: 上下文的唯一 ID，如果没有则为null。

items.source: a display name for this context (never null)
items.translation: 此上下文的显示名称（永远不为null）

items.source: the parent context, or null if there is no parent
items.translation: 父上下文，或者如果没有父上下文则为null。

items.source:
Inheritance from a parent context. Definitions in a descendant context
will always take priority. This means, for example, that a single parent
context can be used by an entire web application, while each servlet has
its own child context that is independent of that of any other servlet.
items.translation: 从父上下文继承。子上下文中的定义将始终具有最高优先级。这意味着，例如，整个 Web 应用程序可以使用单个父上下文，而每个 Servlet 都有其独立的子上下文，该子上下文与其他任何 Servlet 的上下文无关。

items.source: a name for the deployed application, or the empty String by default
items.translation: 部署的应用程序名称，默认为空字符串。

items.source: the timestamp (ms) when this context was first loaded
items.translation: 该上下文首次加载的时间戳（毫秒）

items.source: the AutowireCapableBeanFactory for this context
items.translation: 该上下文的 AutowireCapableBeanFactory

items.source: Expose AutowireCapableBeanFactory functionality for this context.
items.translation: 为此上下文暴露 AutowireCapableBeanFactory 功能。

items.source: Rod Johnson, Juergen Hoeller
items.translation: Rod Johnson，Juergen Hoeller
